# shell-lint.sh - Lint shell scripts with shfmt and shellcheck
#
# Finds all files with shell shebangs or shellcheck directives,
# then runs shfmt and shellcheck on each file.

failed=0
files=$(
    find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print 2>/dev/null |
        while read -r file; do
            head -n1 "$file" 2>/dev/null |
                grep -qE "^#!/(usr/bin/env[[:space:]]+)?(sh|bash)\b|^# shellcheck shell=" &&
                echo "$file"
        done |
        sort
)

for f in $files; do
    shfmt_ok=true
    shellcheck_ok=true
    shfmt -d -i 4 -ci "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || shfmt_ok=false
    shellcheck -x --severity=warning "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || shellcheck_ok=false
    if $shfmt_ok && $shellcheck_ok; then
        echo "✓ $f"
    else
        echo "✗ $f"
        $shfmt_ok || echo "  shfmt: FAIL"
        $shellcheck_ok || echo "  shellcheck: FAIL"
        failed=1
    fi
done

exit $failed

    [string]$Passphrase,

    [Parameter()]
    [string]$Destination,

    [Parameter()]
    [string[]]$Package
)

set -o errexit -o nounset -o pipefail

###########
# Variables
###########

declare -r script_root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
declare -r script_name="$(basename "$0")"
declare -r Heavy_ballot='✘'
declare -r Heavy_check_mark='✔'

export TUCKR_HOME="${TUCKR_HOME:-${script_root}/Home}"

###########
# Functions
###########

function do_install {

    Remove-BrokenLinks

    # Prepare home directory structure

    case ${OS} in
        Darwin)
            run mkdir -p ~/Library/LaunchAgents
            ;;
        Linux)
            ;;
    esac

    # Install functions and link dotfiles using Tuckr

    cd "${TUCKR_HOME}/Configs" && local -a groups=( $(Get-SelectedGroups "$@") )
    Remove-UnselectedGroups "${groups[@]}"
    Add-SelectedGroups "${groups[@]}"

    note "Securing encrypted files"
    run git protect-encrypted-files

    declare -a function_definitions=( ~/.functions/**/*(-.N) )

    if (( ${#function_definitions[@]} > 0 )); then
        note "Compiling zsh functions: ${function_definitions[*]}"
        run zcompile -Uz ~/.functions.zwc "${function_definitions[@]}"
    fi

    # Resolve user identity (use provided values or resolve)

    [[ -z "${user_name:-}" ]] && user_name=$(sudo -u "${SUDO_USER:-$USER}" git config --global user.name 2>/dev/null || true)

    if [[ -z "${user_name:-}" ]]; then
        case ${OS} in
            Darwin)
                user_name=$(dscl . -read "/Users/${SUDO_USER:-$USER}" RealName 2>/dev/null | tail -n1 | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' || true)
                ;;
            Linux)
                gecos=$(getent passwd "${SUDO_USER:-$USER}" | cut -d: -f5)
                user_name=$(echo "${gecos}" | cut -d, -f1)
                ;;
        esac
    fi

    if [[ -z "${user_name:-}" ]]; then
        echo -n "Enter your full name: " >&2
        read user_name
    fi

    [[ -z "${user_email:-}" ]] && user_email=$(sudo -u "${SUDO_USER:-$USER}" git config --global user.email 2>/dev/null || true)

    if [[ -z "${user_email:-}" ]]; then
        case ${OS} in
            Darwin)
                user_email=$(dscl . -read "/Users/${SUDO_USER:-$USER}" EMailAddress 2>/dev/null | tail -n1 | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' || true)
                ;;
            Linux)
                # GECOS field doesn't reliably contain email (standard format is Name,Room,Work,Home)
                # Fall through to interactive prompt
                ;;
        esac
    fi

    if [[ -z "${user_email:-}" ]]; then
        echo -n "Enter your email address: " >&2
        read user_email
    fi

    # Ensure git config includes required files (XDG location)

    note "Ensuring ~/.config/git/config includes config.all, config.os, config.local"

    if $dry_run; then
        if [[ ! -f ~/.config/git/config ]]; then
            note "Would create ~/.config/git/config with include directives"
        else
            for include_path in ./config.all ./config.os ./config.local; do
                if ! grep -q "path = ${include_path}$" ~/.config/git/config; then
                    note "Would append include path ${include_path} to ~/.config/git/config"
                fi
            done
        fi
    else
        mkdir -p ~/.config/git
        if [[ ! -f ~/.config/git/config ]]; then
            cat > ~/.config/git/config <<'EOF'
# Generated by Install-UnixUserConfiguration
[include]
    path = ./config.all
    path = ./config.os
    path = ./config.local
EOF
        else
            for include_path in ./config.all ./config.os ./config.local; do
                if ! grep -q "path = ${include_path}$" ~/.config/git/config; then
                    git config --file ~/.config/git/config --add include.path "${include_path}"
                fi
            done
        fi
    fi

    # Create git config.local with user identity if it doesn't exist

    if [[ ! -f ~/.config/git/config.local ]]; then
        note "Creating ~/.config/git/config.local with user.name=${user_name}, user.email=${user_email}"
        if $dry_run; then
            note "Would create ~/.config/git/config.local with user identity"
        else
            cat > ~/.config/git/config.local <<EOF
# Generated by Install-UnixUserConfiguration
[user]
    name = ${user_name}
    email = ${user_email}
EOF
        fi
    fi

    # Ensure SSH config includes config.d directory

    note "Ensuring ${HOME}/.ssh/config includes config.d/"

    if $dry_run; then
        if [[ ! -f ~/.ssh/config ]]; then
            note "Would create ~/.ssh/config with Include directive"
        elif ! grep -q '^Include \./config\.d/\*$' ~/.ssh/config; then
            note "Would append Include directive to ~/.ssh/config"
        else
            note "~/.ssh/config already includes config.d/"
        fi
    else
        mkdir -p ~/.ssh
        if [[ ! -f ~/.ssh/config ]]; then
            cat > ~/.ssh/config <<'EOF'
# Generated by Install-UnixUserConfiguration
Include ./config.d/*
EOF
        elif ! grep -q '^Include \./config\.d/\*$' ~/.ssh/config; then
            echo 'Include ./config.d/*' >> ~/.ssh/config
        fi
    fi

    # Initialize SSH identity (default Host settings and key loading)

    run ~/local/bin/Initialize-SshIdentity $($force && echo --force)

    # Combine authorized keys into a single file for use by the ssh client

    declare -a authorized_keys=( ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.d/*(N) )

    if (( ${#authorized_keys[@]} > 0 )); then
        note "Generating ${HOME}/.ssh/authorized_keys"
        if $dry_run; then
            note "Would concatenate ${#authorized_keys[@]} files from ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.d/"
        else
            cat ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.d/*(N) > ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
        fi
    fi

    # Configure tuckr environment (creates ~/.config/sh/env.d/tuckr.sh)

    if $dry_run; then
        note "Would run: Complete-TuckrSetup --tuckr-home ${TUCKR_HOME}"
    else
        ~/local/bin/Complete-TuckrSetup --tuckr-home "${TUCKR_HOME}"
    fi

    success "Installation complete."
}

function Add-SelectedGroups {
    # Adds symlinks for selected groups
    # Arguments: group names to add

    if (( $# > 0 )); then
        note "Deploying groups: $*"
        local error_message
        if ! error_message=$(tuckr $($dry_run && echo --dry-run) add $($adopt && echo --adopt) $($force && echo --force) --assume-yes --only-files "$@" 2>&1); then
            if $dry_run; then
                error 0 "tuckr dry-run failed: ${error_message}"
            else
                error 1 "${error_message}"
            fi
        fi
    fi
}

function Ensure-TuckrVersion {
    # Ensure the required version of tuckr is installed
    # Currently requires git master due to issue #122: https://github.com/RaphGL/Tuckr/issues/122

    grep -q 'git+https://github.com/RaphGL/Tuckr' ~/.local/.crates2.json 2>/dev/null && return 0

    run mkdir -p ~/local/bin
    run ln -sf "${script_root}/Home/Configs/all/local/bin/Declare-BashScript" ~/local/bin/
    [[ ${OS} == Linux ]] && run ln -sf "${script_root}/Home/Configs/all-Linux/local/bin/Install-Rust" ~/local/bin/
    run ln -sf "${script_root}/Home/Configs/all-${OS}/local/bin/Install-Tuckr" ~/local/bin/
    run ln -sf "${script_root}/Home/Configs/all/local/bin/git-protect-encrypted-files" ~/local/bin/

    [[ ":${PATH}:" != *":${HOME}/local/bin:"* ]] && export PATH="${HOME}/local/bin:${PATH}"

    if $dry_run; then
        note "Would run: Install-Tuckr"
    else
        Install-Tuckr
    fi
}

function Get-SelectedGroups {
    # Prints groups to install based on OS and selected packages
    # Must be called from Home/Configs directory
    # Arguments: package names to include

    local -a groups=(
        $([[ -d all ]] && echo "all" || :)
        $([[ -d all-${OS} ]] && echo "all-${OS}" || :)
        $([[ -n "${DISTRO:-}" && -d "all-${DISTRO}" ]] && echo "all-${DISTRO}" || :)
        $([[ ${OS} == Darwin || ${OS} == Linux ]] && [[ -d "all-Unix" ]] && echo "all-Unix" || :)
    )

    for package in "$@"; do groups+=(
        $([[ -d "${package}" ]] && echo "${package}" || :)
        $([[ -d "${package}-${OS}" ]] && echo "${package}-${OS}" || :)
        $([[ -n "${DISTRO:-}" && -d "${package}-${DISTRO}" ]] && echo "${package}-${DISTRO}" || :)
        $([[ ${OS} == Darwin || ${OS} == Linux ]] && [[ -d "${package}-Unix" ]] && echo "${package}-Unix" || :)
    )
    done

    print -r -- "${groups[@]}"
}

function Remove-BrokenLinks {
    note "Removing broken links from ${HOME}"

    if $dry_run; then
        note "Would find and remove broken symlinks in ${HOME}"
    else
        find "$HOME" -xdev \( \
            -path "$HOME/.Trash" -o \
            -path "$HOME/.cache" -o \
            -path "$HOME/.cargo" -o \
            -path "$HOME/.npm" -o \
            -path "$HOME/Library/Application Support" -o \
            -path "$HOME/Library/Caches" -o \
            -path "$HOME/Library/Containers" -o \
            -path "$HOME/Library/Cookies" -o \
            -path "$HOME/Library/Group Containers" -o \
            -path "$HOME/Library/Saved Application State" -o \
            -path "$HOME/Library/WebKit" -o \
            -path "$HOME/OrbStack" -o \
            -path "$HOME/Pictures/Photo Booth Library" -o \
            -path "$HOME/Pictures/Photos Library.photoslibrary" -o \
            -name node_modules -o \
            -name .git \
        \) -prune -o -xtype l -print -exec rm -v {} + 2>/dev/null || :
    fi
}

function Remove-UnselectedGroups {
    # Removes symlinks for groups NOT in the selected set
    # Must be called from Home/Configs directory
    # Arguments: group names to keep

    local -a groups=( "$@" )
    local -a all_groups=( *(/) )
    local -a to_remove=()

    for group in "${all_groups[@]}"; do
        if (( ! ${groups[(Ie)$group]} )); then
            to_remove+=("$group")
        fi
    done

    if (( ${#to_remove[@]} > 0 )); then
        note "Removing unselected groups: ${to_remove[*]}"
        if $dry_run; then
            note "Would run: tuckr rm ${to_remove[*]}"
        else
            tuckr rm "${to_remove[@]}"
        fi
    fi
}

function on_error {
    local exit_code=${1:-$?}
    local source
    local line

    if (( ${#funcfiletrace[@]} > 0 )); then
        source="${funcfiletrace[1]%%:*}"
        line="${funcfiletrace[1]#*:}"
        line="${line%%:*}"
    else
        source="${script_name}"
        line=${LINENO}
    fi

    error "$exit_code" "Exiting due to error at $source line $line (exit $exit_code)"
}

function error {
    local rc=$1
    shift 1
    printf '[%s] [\033[31m%s\033[0m] %s\n' "$script_name" "$Heavy_ballot" "$@" >&2
    if ((rc != 0)); then
        exit "$rc"
    fi
}

function note {
    printf "[%s] [+] %s\n" "$script_name" "$@" >&2
}

function run {
    if $dry_run; then
        note "Would run: $*"
    else
        "$@"
    fi
}

function success {
    printf '[%s] [\033[32m%s\033[0m] %s\n' "$script_name" "$Heavy_check_mark" "$@" >&2
}

        --user-email)
            user_email="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        --)
            shift 1
            break
            ;;

            ;;
    esac
done

readonly dry_run adopt force

############
# Main
############

trap 'on_error $?' ERR

if [[ ":${PATH}:" != *":${HOME}/.local/bin:"* ]]; then
    export PATH="${HOME}/.local/bin:${PATH}"
fi

            ;;

# Sync-CommonBuildTools - Sync common build tools between source and target directories
#
# Uses rsync with --existing to copy only files that exist in both source and target.
# Syncs build/ (including subdirectories like templates/), share/man/man1/,
# share/bash-completion/completions/, and share/zsh/site-functions/.

source "$(dirname "$0")/Home/Configs/all/local/bin/Declare-BashScript" "$0" "help,source:,target:,dry-run,verbose" "hs:t:nv" "$@"

###########
# Arguments
###########

declare -r synopsis="Sync-CommonBuildTools --source <dir> --target <dir> [--dry-run] [--verbose] [--help]"
eval set -- "$script_arguments"

dry_run=0
verbose=0

while :; do
    case $1 in
        -h | --help)
            usage "$synopsis"
            ;;
        -s | --source)
            source_dir="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        -t | --target)
            target_dir="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        -n | --dry-run)
            dry_run=1
            shift 1
            ;;
        -v | --verbose)
            verbose=1
            shift 1
            ;;
        --)
            shift 1
            break
            ;;
        *) error $EX_USAGE "Unrecognized option: $1" ;;
    esac
done

[[ -n "${source_dir:-}" ]] || error $EX_USAGE "Missing required option: --source"
[[ -n "${target_dir:-}" ]] || error $EX_USAGE "Missing required option: --target"

# Expand tilde in paths
source_dir="${source_dir/#\~/$HOME}"
target_dir="${target_dir/#\~/$HOME}"

[[ -d "${source_dir}" ]] || error $EX_NOINPUT "Source directory does not exist: ${source_dir}"
[[ -d "${target_dir}" ]] || error $EX_NOINPUT "Target directory does not exist: ${target_dir}"

###########
# Variables
###########

declare -r source_build="${source_dir}/build"
declare -r source_share="${source_dir}/share"

declare -r target_build="${target_dir}/build"
declare -r target_share="${target_dir}/share"

[[ -d "${source_build}" ]] || error $EX_NOINPUT "Source build directory does not exist: ${source_build}"
[[ -d "${target_build}" ]] || error $EX_NOINPUT "Target build directory does not exist: ${target_build}"

###########
# Functions
###########

run_rsync() {
    local src="$1"
    local dst="$2"
    local label="$3"

    if [[ ! -d "${src}" ]]; then
        ((verbose)) && note "Skipping ${label}: source directory does not exist"
        return 0
    fi

    if [[ ! -d "${dst}" ]]; then
        ((verbose)) && note "Skipping ${label}: target directory does not exist"
        return 0
    fi

    local -a rsync_opts=(-a --existing)
    ((dry_run)) && rsync_opts+=(--dry-run)
    ((verbose)) && rsync_opts+=(--itemize-changes)

    note "Syncing ${label}..."
    rsync "${rsync_opts[@]}" "${src}/" "${dst}/"
}

###########
# Main
###########

note "Syncing common build tools from ${source_dir} to ${target_dir}"
((dry_run)) && note "[dry-run mode]"

# Sync build/ directory (includes subdirectories like templates/)
run_rsync "${source_build}" "${target_build}" "build/"

# Sync share/ subdirectories for man pages and shell completions
run_rsync "${source_share}/man/man1" "${target_share}/man/man1" "share/man/man1/"
run_rsync "${source_share}/bash-completion/completions" "${target_share}/bash-completion/completions" "share/bash-completion/completions/"
run_rsync "${source_share}/zsh/site-functions" "${target_share}/zsh/site-functions" "share/zsh/site-functions/"

if ((dry_run)); then
    success "[dry-run] Sync complete (no changes made)"
else
    success "Sync complete"
fi

[CmdletBinding(PositionalBinding = $false)]
param()

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

if ([Environment]::OSVersion.Platform -eq [PlatformID]::Win32NT) {

    $machinePath = [System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[object]]::new((
        [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Machine) -split [Path]::PathSeparator |
        ForEach-Object { [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($_) } |
        Where-Object { Test-Path -PathType Container $_ } |
        ForEach-Object { Resolve-Path $_ } |
        ForEach-Object { $_ -ireplace '(.)\\?$', '$1\'} |
        ForEach-Object { $_ -ireplace "^$($env:ProgramData -ireplace '\\', '\\')\\", "%ProgramData%\" } |
        ForEach-Object { $_ -ireplace "^$(${env:ProgramFiles(x86)} -ireplace '(\\|\(|\))', '\$1')\\", "%ProgramFiles(x86)%\" } |
        ForEach-Object { $_ -ireplace "^$($env:ProgramFiles -ireplace '\\', '\\')\\", "%ProgramFiles%\" } |
        ForEach-Object { $_ -ireplace "^$($env:SystemRoot -ireplace '\\', '\\')\\?", "%SystemRoot%\" } |
        Where-Object { $_ -ne '%ProgramFiles%\Git\usr\bin\' } |
        Sort-Object))

    # Git's /usr/bin includes ssh and vim. You must use OpenSsh on Windows because it's the only reliable ssh on the platform. Not using Git's vim is a preference.
    [void]$machinePath.Add('%ProgramFiles%\Git\usr\bin\')

    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', ($machinePath -join [Path]::PathSeparator), [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Machine)

    $userPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::User) -split [Path]::PathSeparator |
        ForEach-Object { [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($_) } |
        Where-Object { Test-Path -PathType Container $_ } |
        ForEach-Object { Resolve-Path $_ } |
        ForEach-Object { $_ -ireplace '(.)\\?$', '$1\'} |
        ForEach-Object { $_ -ireplace "^$($env:APPDATA -ireplace '\\', '\\')\\", "%APPDATA%\" } |

        Sort-Object | Select-Object -Unique

    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', ($userPath -join [Path]::PathSeparator), [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::User)
    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables(($userPath + $machinePath) -join [Path]::PathSeparator), [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Process)

    Write-Information -InformationAction Continue "You should ensure that the Machine and User paths are arranged correctly. They are sorted alphabetically with one exception. %ProgramFiles%\Git\usr\bin\ is at the end of the Machine Path."

    [PSCustomObject] @{
        "Name" = 'PATH'

        "Value" =  [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('PATH', [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Machine) -split [Path]::PathSeparator
    }

    [PSCustomObject] @{
        "Name" = 'PATH'
        "Target" = [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::User
        "Value" =  [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('PATH', [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::User) -split [Path]::PathSeparator
    }
}
else {
    $processPath = [System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[object]]::new((
        [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('PATH', [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Process) -split [Path]::PathSeparator |
        ForEach-Object { [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($_) } |
        Where-Object { Test-Path -PathType Container $_ } |
        ForEach-Object { Resolve-Path $_ }))
    [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('PATH', [Environment]::ExpandEnvironmentVariables($processPath -join [Path]::PathSeparator), [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Process)
}

[PSCustomObject] @{
    "Name" = 'PATH'
    "Target" = [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Process
    "Value" =  [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('PATH', [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Process) -split [Path]::PathSeparator
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Initializes a Windows 11 system with development tools and personal configuration.

.DESCRIPTION
    Initialize-Windows sets up a Windows development environment including:
    - Development tools via winget (Git, JDK, .NET, Node.js, Python, Rust, Go, etc.)
    - WSL2 with Ubuntu
    - Apache Maven
    - PowerShell modules (Az, posh-git, PSReadLine)
    - OpenSSH client and server with hardened configuration
    - git-crypt for repository encryption
    - tuckr for dotfiles management
    - Personal dotfiles and configuration from the Personal repository

    Prerequisites: .Personal-secrets and .ssh directories must be pre-populated
    with GPG keys, SSH keys, and configuration files.

.PARAMETER UserName
    User's full name for git configuration. If not specified, attempts to resolve
    from git global config, Windows user profile, or prompts interactively.

.PARAMETER UserEmail
    User's email address for git configuration. If not specified, attempts to
    resolve from git global config or prompts interactively.

.EXAMPLE
    .\Initialize-Windows.ps1
    Initializes the system, prompting for user identity if needed.

.EXAMPLE
    .\Initialize-Windows.ps1 -UserName "David Noble" -UserEmail "david@example.com"
    Initializes the system with the specified user identity.

.EXAMPLE
    .\Initialize-Windows.ps1 -Verbose
    Initializes the system with detailed progress output.

.NOTES
    Requires PowerShell 7.0 or later.
    Requires administrator privileges.
    Requires Windows 11 or later.
    Requires winget (App Installer) to be installed.
#>

#Requires -Version 7.0
#Requires -RunAsAdministrator

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(HelpMessage = "User's full name for git config")]
    [string]$UserName,

    [Parameter(HelpMessage = "User's email for git config")]
    [string]$UserEmail,

    [Parameter(HelpMessage = "Additional winget package IDs to install")]
    [string[]]$Package
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

# Require Windows
if (-not $IsWindows) {
    throw "This script requires Windows."
}

# Require Windows 11 or later
$osVersion = [System.Environment]::OSVersion.Version
if ($osVersion.Build -lt 22000) {
    throw "Windows 11 or later required. Found: Windows build $($osVersion.Build)"
}

# Require winget
if (-not (Get-Command winget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    throw "winget is not installed. Install App Installer from the Microsoft Store."
}

############
# Functions
############

function Install-WingetPackage {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
        [string]$PackageId,

        [string]$Source = "winget"
    )

    $installed = winget list --id $PackageId --source $Source 2>$null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $installed -match [regex]::Escape($PackageId)) {
        Write-Verbose "Already installed: $PackageId"
        return
    }

    Write-Information "Installing: $PackageId" -InformationAction Continue
    winget install --id $PackageId --source $Source --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements --silent
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Warning "Failed to install: $PackageId"
    }
}

function Resolve-UserIdentity {
    [CmdletBinding()]
    param(
        [string]$Name,
        [string]$Email
    )

    # Resolve name
    $Name ??= git config --global user.name 2>$null
    $Name ??= (Get-LocalUser -Name $env:USERNAME -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).FullName
    $Name ??= Read-Host "Enter your full name"

    # Resolve email
    $Email ??= git config --global user.email 2>$null
    $Email ??= Read-Host "Enter your email address"

    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Name  = $Name
        Email = $Email
    }

    # Import GPG keys if available

        'GitHub.cli',
        'GoLang.Go',
        'Insecure.Nmap',
        'JetBrains.Toolbox',
        'Microsoft.AzureCLI',
        'Microsoft.DotNet.SDK.10',
        'Microsoft.VisualStudioCode',
        'OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS',

    # Install additional packages from -Package parameter
    if ($Package) {

    # https://github.com/RaphGL/Tuckr/issues/122
    if (-not (Get-Command tuckr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        Write-Information "Installing tuckr from git master..." -InformationAction Continue
        cargo install --root "$homeDir\.local" --git https://github.com/RaphGL/Tuckr tuckr
    }

    # Install pre-commit
    if (-not (Get-Command pre-commit -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
        Write-Information "Installing pre-commit..." -InformationAction Continue
        pip install pre-commit
    }

    # Install Apache Maven
    Write-Information "Installing Apache Maven..." -InformationAction Continue
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "Install-ApacheMaven.ps1")

    # Install WSL2 with Ubuntu
    Write-Information "Checking WSL2..." -InformationAction Continue
    wsl --status 2>$null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Information "Installing WSL2 with Ubuntu..." -InformationAction Continue
        wsl --install --distribution Ubuntu --no-launch
        Write-Warning "WSL2 installed. A reboot is required to complete setup."
    }
    else {
        Write-Verbose "WSL2 already installed"
    }

    # Install git-crypt (latest Windows release from GitHub)
    $localBin = Join-Path $homeDir ".local\bin"
    if (-not (Test-Path $localBin)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $localBin -Force | Out-Null
    }
    $gitCryptPath = Join-Path $localBin "git-crypt.exe"
    if (-not (Test-Path $gitCryptPath)) {
        Write-Information "Installing git-crypt..." -InformationAction Continue
        $releases = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/AGWA/git-crypt/releases"
        $asset = $releases | ForEach-Object { $_.assets } | Where-Object { $_.name -like "*x86_64.exe" } | Select-Object -First 1
        if (-not $asset) {
            throw "Could not find git-crypt Windows binary in any release"
        }
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $asset.browser_download_url -OutFile $gitCryptPath -UseBasicParsing
    }

    # Install PowerShell modules
    @('Az', 'posh-git', 'PSReadLine') | ForEach-Object {
        if (-not (Get-Module -ListAvailable -Name $_)) {
            Write-Information "Installing PowerShell module: $_" -InformationAction Continue
            Install-Module -Name $_ -Scope CurrentUser -Force -AllowClobber
        }
    }

    # Configure OpenSSH
    Write-Information "Configuring OpenSSH..." -InformationAction Continue
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "Initialize-OpenSsh.ps1")

    # Enable long paths
    $longPathsKey = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem"
    $currentValue = Get-ItemProperty -Path $longPathsKey -Name LongPathsEnabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($currentValue.LongPathsEnabled -ne 1) {
        Set-ItemProperty -Path $longPathsKey -Name LongPathsEnabled -Value 1
        Write-Information "Enabled long path support" -InformationAction Continue
    }

    # Enable Developer Mode
    $devModeKey = "HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AppModelUnlock"
    $currentValue = Get-ItemProperty -Path $devModeKey -Name AllowDevelopmentWithoutDevLicense -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($currentValue.AllowDevelopmentWithoutDevLicense -ne 1) {
        Set-ItemProperty -Path $devModeKey -Name AllowDevelopmentWithoutDevLicense -Value 1
        Write-Information "Enabled Developer Mode" -InformationAction Continue
    }

    # Clone or update Personal repository
    $workspaceDir = Join-Path $homeDir "Workspace"
    Push-Location $workspaceDir
    try {
        if (Test-Path "Personal") {
            Write-Information "Updating Personal repository..." -InformationAction Continue
            git -C Personal pull --all
        }
        else {
            Write-Information "Cloning Personal repository..." -InformationAction Continue
            git config --global credential.canFallBackToInsecureStore true
            git clone git@github.com:David-Noble-at-work/personal.git Personal
            git -C Personal checkout develop
        }

        # Unlock git-crypt if available
        $gitCryptSmudge = git -C Personal config --local --get filter.git-crypt.smudge 2>$null
        if (-not $gitCryptSmudge -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $homeDir ".Personal-secrets"))) {
            Write-Information "Unlocking git-crypt..." -InformationAction Continue
            Push-Location Personal
            git-crypt unlock
            Pop-Location
        }

        # Install pre-commit hooks
        Push-Location Personal
        pre-commit install
        Pop-Location

        # Add local\bin and .local\bin to user PATH before running install script
        $pathsToAdd = @(
            (Join-Path $homeDir "local\bin"),
            (Join-Path $homeDir ".local\bin")
        )
        $userPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::User)
        foreach ($pathToAdd in $pathsToAdd) {
            if ($userPath -notlike "*$pathToAdd*") {
                $userPath = "$userPath;$pathToAdd"
                $env:Path = "$env:Path;$pathToAdd"
                Write-Information "Added $pathToAdd to user PATH" -InformationAction Continue
            }
        }
        [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', $userPath, [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::User)

        # Run install script
        Write-Information "Running install script..." -InformationAction Continue
        $installScript = Join-Path $workspaceDir "Personal\Install-WindowsUserConfiguration.ps1"
        if (Test-Path $installScript) {
            & $installScript -Force -Package $Package
        }
    }
    finally {
        Pop-Location
    }

    # Secure directories
    Write-Information "Securing sensitive directories..." -InformationAction Continue
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "FixUp-Acls.ps1")

    Write-Information "Fixing up PATH variables..." -InformationAction Continue
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "FixUp-Path.ps1")

    Write-Information "Windows initialization complete!" -InformationAction Continue
    Write-Warning "A reboot may be required to complete WSL2 and Docker Desktop setup."
}
catch {
    Write-Error "Initialization failed: $_"
}

.SH DESCRIPTION
.B Build-WindowsInitializationPackage
creates a self-extracting PowerShell script with an embedded GPG-encrypted payload
for Windows 11 systems.
The package bundles the
.I Initialize-Windows.ps1
script along with SSH keys, GPG keys, and personal secrets.

The resulting script can be copied to a target Windows system and executed to bootstrap
a complete development environment. It:
.RS
.IP \(bu 2
Installs Git via winget if not present
.IP \(bu 2
Uses Git Bash to decrypt and extract the payload
.IP \(bu 2
Runs Initialize-Windows.ps1 to complete setup
.RE

.SS Remote Deployment
The self-extracting package supports remote deployment via SSH:
.PP
.nf
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File windows-initialization.<date>.<sha>.ps1 \\
    -Passphrase <passphrase> -Destination user@host
.fi

.SH OPTIONS
.TP
.BR \-h ", " \-\-help
Display usage information and exit.

.TP
.BR \-p ", " \-\-package\-list " \fIlist\fR"
Comma-separated list of winget package IDs to install.
These are embedded in the self-extracting script and passed to Initialize-Windows.ps1
via the \fB\-Package\fR parameter.

.TP
.BR \-P ", " \-\-passphrase\-env " \fINAME\fR"
Name of an environment variable containing the encryption passphrase.
If omitted, the command prompts interactively.

.SH STANDARD PACKAGES
The following are installed by \fBInitialize-Windows.ps1\fR regardless of \fB\-\-package\-list\fR:
.PP
.RS
Azul.Zulu.25.JDK, GitHub.cli, GoLang.Go, Insecure.Nmap, JetBrains.Toolbox,
Microsoft.AzureCLI, Microsoft.DotNet.SDK.10, Microsoft.VisualStudioCode,
OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS, PostgreSQL.PostgreSQL.17, Python.Python.3.14,
Rclone.Rclone, Rustlang.Rustup, vim.vim, Git.Git, GnuPG.GnuPG
.RE
.PP
Additionally installed:
.RS
.IP \(bu 2
\fBWSL2 with Ubuntu\fR \- Windows Subsystem for Linux
.IP \(bu 2
\fBApache Maven\fR \- Java build tool
.IP \(bu 2
\fBgit-crypt\fR \- repository encryption (from GitHub releases)
.IP \(bu 2
\fBtuckr\fR \- dotfiles manager (via cargo)
.IP \(bu 2
\fBPowerShell modules\fR \- Az, posh-git, PSReadLine
.RE

.SH PACKAGE LIST PACKAGES
Use \fB\-\-package\-list\fR to add winget packages beyond the standard set.
.PP
.nf
$ Build-WindowsInitializationPackage -p "Docker.DockerDesktop,Hashicorp.Terraform"
.fi
.PP
At runtime, you can also override or extend via the \fB\-Package\fR parameter:
.PP
.nf
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File windows-initialization.ps1 \\
    -Passphrase <passphrase> -Package Docker.DockerDesktop,Hashicorp.Terraform
.fi

.SH EXIT STATUS
.TP
.B 0
Success.
.TP
.B non-zero
Error (missing files, tar failure, GPG failure).

.SH EXAMPLES
Create a package with interactive passphrase prompt:
.PP
.nf
$ Build-WindowsInitializationPackage
.fi
.PP
Create a package with passphrase from environment:
.PP
.nf
$ export WIN_PASSPHRASE="secret"
$ Build-WindowsInitializationPackage -P WIN_PASSPHRASE
.fi
.PP
Include additional winget packages:
.PP
.nf
$ Build-WindowsInitializationPackage -p "Docker.DockerDesktop,Slack.Slack"
.fi
.PP
Run the generated package on Windows:
.PP
.nf
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File windows-initialization.2025-01-04.abc1234.ps1 \\
    -Passphrase "secret"
.fi
.PP
Deploy to a remote Windows machine via SSH:
.PP
.nf
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File windows-initialization.2025-01-04.abc1234.ps1 \\
    -Passphrase "secret" -Destination user@remote
.fi

.SH FILES
.TP
.I build/
Working directory; output is written here.
.TP
.I windows-initialization.<date>.<git-sha>.ps1
The self-extracting PowerShell script with embedded encrypted payload.

.TH INSTALL-UNIXUSERCONFIGURATION 1 "January 2026" "Noble Factor" "User Commands"
.SH NAME
Install-UnixUserConfiguration \- bootstrap personal development environment and dotfiles
.SH SYNOPSIS
.B Install-UnixUserConfiguration
.RB [ \-h | \-\-help ]
.RB [ \-\-dry\-run ]
.RI [ package ...]
.SH DESCRIPTION
.B Install-UnixUserConfiguration
detects the operating system and distribution, prepares the home directory structure, links dotfiles using Tuckr, compiles zsh functions, and writes a curated
.I ~/.gitconfig
appropriate to the host OS.
.PP
Package names correspond to Tuckr group directories under
.IR Home/Configs/ .
The script automatically includes OS- and distribution-specific variants when present, such as
.I <package>-Darwin
or
.IR <package>-<DISTRO> .
.SH BOOTSTRAPPING
Tuckr is required to deploy dotfiles but may not be installed on a fresh system.
The script bootstraps tuckr by temporarily linking the
.B Install-Tuckr
script and its dependencies to
.I ~/local/bin
before invoking it.
.PP
Tuckr is installed from git master rather than crates.io because the latest
release (0.12.0) contains a critical bug where running
.B tuckr add
twice causes symlinks to become empty directories.
See
.UR https://github.com/RaphGL/Tuckr/issues/122
GitHub issue #122
.UE
for details.
The fix is committed to master but not yet released.
See also
.I tuckr-bug-report/README.md
in the repository.
.PP
.B Files linked for bootstrapping:
.TP
.B Darwin
.nf
Home/Configs/all/local/bin/Declare-BashScript
Home/Configs/all-Darwin/local/bin/Install-Tuckr
Home/Configs/all/local/bin/git-protect-encrypted-files
.fi
.TP
.B Linux
.nf
Home/Configs/all/local/bin/Declare-BashScript
Home/Configs/all-Linux/local/bin/Install-Rust
Home/Configs/all-Linux/local/bin/Install-Tuckr
Home/Configs/all/local/bin/git-protect-encrypted-files
.fi
.PP
These symlinks are placed in
.I ~/local/bin
so that
.B Install-Tuckr
can locate
.B Declare-BashScript
via
.IR "$(dirname \(dq$0\(dq)" .
After tuckr is installed, the full dotfiles deployment creates permanent symlinks.
.SH OPERATIONS
The script performs the following operations:
.TP
.B 1.
Detects the operating system (Darwin, Linux, Windows) and distribution (from /etc/os-release on Linux).
.TP
.B 2.
Creates necessary directory structure in the home directory (e.g., ~/Library/LaunchAgents on macOS, PowerShell directories on Windows).
.TP
.B 3.
Uses Tuckr to symlink dotfiles from the specified packages with
.BR \-\-only\-files
(creating directories, symlinking files).
.TP
.B 4.
Secures ~/.ssh directory and files with appropriate permissions (go-rwx).
.TP
.B 5.
Compiles zsh function definitions into
.I ~/.functions.zwc
for improved shell startup performance.
.TP
.B 6.
Resolves user identity from git global config, system directories (dscl on macOS, GECOS on Linux), or interactive prompts.
.TP
.B 7.
Generates
.I ~/.gitconfig
with user identity and OS-specific tool configuration.
.TP
.B 8.
Concatenates authorized keys from ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.d/ into ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.
.TP
.B 9.
Removes broken symlinks from the home directory.
.SH OPTIONS
.TP
.BR \-h ", " \-\-help
Print synopsis and exit.
.TP
.B \-\-dry\-run
Show what would be done without making changes.
.SH ARGUMENTS
.TP
.I package
One or more Tuckr group names to deploy from
.IR Home/Configs/ .
OS and distribution variants (e.g.,
.IR microsoft-Darwin ,
.IR thenobles-Windows )
are automatically detected and applied. Available packages include:
.BR microsoft ,
.BR noblefactor ,
.BR thenobles .
.SH ENVIRONMENT
.TP
.B OSTYPE
Shell-provided OS signature used to determine the operating system.
.TP
.B OS
Normalized OS identifier (Darwin | Linux | Windows). Can be set explicitly to override detection.
.TP
.B DISTRO
Linux distribution ID derived from /etc/os-release (e.g., debian, ubuntu, fedora).
.TP
.B TUCKR_HOME
Set by the script to the repository root directory.
.SH FILES
.TP
.I Home/Configs/
Directory containing Tuckr groups for dotfiles and configuration.
.TP
.I ~/.functions/
Directory containing zsh function definitions.
.TP
.I ~/.functions.zwc
Compiled zsh function definitions for improved performance.
.TP
.I ~/.ssh/
SSH directory secured with go-rwx permissions.
.TP
.I ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
Concatenation of all files in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.d/.
.TP
.I ~/.gitconfig
Generated git configuration file with user identity and OS-specific settings.
.SH EXIT STATUS
.TP
.B 0
Success.
.TP
.B 64
Usage error (unrecognized option).
.TP
.B non-zero
An error occurred. Errors are trapped and reported with the failing source file and line number.
.SH EXAMPLES
Install base packages only (all, all-Darwin/all-Linux):
.PP
.nf
\&./Install-UnixUserConfiguration
.fi
.PP
Install specific packages with OS-specific variants:
.PP
.nf
\&./Install-UnixUserConfiguration microsoft thenobles
.fi
.PP
This will install: all, all-Darwin, microsoft, microsoft-Darwin, thenobles, and thenobles-Darwin (if they exist).
.PP
Preview changes without applying:
.PP
.nf
\&./Install-UnixUserConfiguration --dry-run noblefactor
.fi
